\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 230-233 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R238-first-pass-words-from-chapters-230-233}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a goldsmith and a potter.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a granddaughter, a father-in-law, a mother-in-law, a bridegroom, a bride
  \item an opinion, a lie, a secret, a joke, laughter
  \item failure, a torch, a battery, a chain, a screw
  \item fog, dew, hail, an earthquake, a flood
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A granddaughter? (\textbf{\ur{پوتی}}, \emph{potī}.) A father-in-law? (\textbf{\ur{سسر}}, \emph{sasur}.) A mother-in-law? (\textbf{\ur{ساس}}, \emph{sās}.) A bridegroom? (\textbf{\ur{دولہا}}, \emph{dūlhā}.) A bride? (\textbf{\ur{دلہن}}, \emph{dulhan}.) An opinion? (\textbf{\ur{رائے}}, \emph{rāe}.) A lie? (\textbf{\ur{جھوٹ}}, \emph{jhūṭ}.) A secret? (\textbf{\ur{راز}}, \emph{rāz}.) A joke? (\textbf{\ur{لطیفہ}}, \emph{latīfā}.) Laughter? (\textbf{\ur{ہنسی}}, \emph{hãsī}.) Failure? (\textbf{\ur{ناکامی}}, \emph{nākāmī}.) A torch? (\textbf{\ur{ٹارچ}}, \emph{ṭārch}.) A battery? (\textbf{\ur{بیٹری}}, \emph{baiṭrī}.) A chain? (\textbf{\ur{زنجیر}}, \emph{zanjīr}.) A screw? (\textbf{\ur{پیچ}}, \emph{pech}.) Fog? (\textbf{\ur{کہرا}}, \emph{kohrā}.) Dew? (\textbf{\ur{اوس}}, \emph{os}.) Hail? (\textbf{\ur{اولے}}, \emph{ole}.) An earthquake? (\textbf{\ur{زلزلہ}}, \emph{zalzalā}.) A flood? (\textbf{\ur{سیلاب}}, \emph{sailāb}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 234-238 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R238-second-pass-words-from-chapters-234-238}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a poppadom and a puri.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a poppadom, a puri, haleem, nihari, minced meat
  \item an insect, a firefly, a bedbug, a crab, a prawn
  \item savings, a price, a shopkeeper, a customer, business
  \item a mechanic, a waiter, a watchman, a soldier; a constable, an army
  \item an expert, an artist, a craftsman, a goldsmith, a potter
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A poppadom? (\textbf{\ur{پاپڑ}}, \emph{pāpaṛ}.) A puri? (\textbf{\ur{پوری}}, \emph{pūrī}.) Haleem? (\textbf{\ur{حلیم}}, \emph{halīm}.) Nihari? (\textbf{\ur{نہاری}}, \emph{nihārī}.) Minced meat? (\textbf{\ur{قیمہ}}, \emph{qīmā}.) An insect? (\textbf{\ur{کیڑا}}, \emph{kīṛā}.) A firefly? (\textbf{\ur{جگنو}}, \emph{jugnū}.) A bedbug? (\textbf{\ur{کھٹمل}}, \emph{khaṭmal}.) A crab? (\textbf{\ur{کیکڑا}}, \emph{kekṛā}.) A prawn? (\textbf{\ur{جھینگا}}, \emph{jhīṅgā}.) Savings? (\textbf{\ur{بچت}}, \emph{bachat}.) A price? (\textbf{\ur{قیمت}}, \emph{qīmat}.) A shopkeeper? (\textbf{\ur{دکاندار}}, \emph{dukāndār}.) A customer? (\textbf{\ur{گاہک}}, \emph{gāhak}.) Business? (\textbf{\ur{کاروبار}}, \emph{kārobār}.) A mechanic? (\textbf{\ur{مستری}}, \emph{mistrī}.) A waiter? (\textbf{\ur{بیرا}}, \emph{berā}.) A watchman? (\textbf{\ur{چوکیدار}}, \emph{chaukīdār}.) A soldier; a constable? (\textbf{\ur{سپاہی}}, \emph{sipāhī}.) An army? (\textbf{\ur{فوج}}, \emph{fauj}.) An expert? (\textbf{\ur{ماہر}}, \emph{māhir}.) An artist? (\textbf{\ur{فنکار}}, \emph{fankār}.) A craftsman? (\textbf{\ur{کاریگر}}, \emph{kārīgar}.) A goldsmith? (\textbf{\ur{سنار}}, \emph{sunār}.) A potter? (\textbf{\ur{کمہار}}, \emph{kumhār}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
